name: CIS Controls
full_name: CIS Critical Security Controls v8.1 readiness: HCG control set organized by the 18 CIS Controls
issuing_body: Heights Consulting Group, organized on the CIS Critical Security Controls v8.1 (Center for Internet Security)
notice: HCG readiness control set organized by the 18 CIS Critical Security Controls v8.1. The names of the 18 Controls are taken from CIS's public list; the Safeguards, their numbering and the Implementation Group assignments are published by CIS under a non-commercial licence and are not reproduced. Controls here are HCG-written, carry HCG numbering, and note the lowest Implementation Group they correspond to.

sources.title: The 18 CIS Critical Security Controls (public list)
HCG CIS Controls readiness control set: controls, guidance and test points

control_flags.type: hcg for an HCG-written readiness control.

scoring.summary: Percentage of applicable controls implemented, with partial implementation counting as half. CIS defines no certification score; this percentage is an HCG readiness measure.

rules.summary: A control is implemented only when every HCG test point under it is met.

Controls apply according to the organization's target Implementation Group: an IG1 organization is assessed on controls marked IG1; IG2 adds those marked IG2; IG3 adds those marked IG3. Controls above the target group are marked not applicable.
rules.quote: The CIS Critical Security Controls (CIS Controls) are a prescriptive, prioritized, and simplified set of best practices

rules.summary: In the implementation score a partially implemented control counts as half. This is an HCG convention.

glossary.definition: A prioritized set of 18 cybersecurity controls published by the Center for Internet Security.
A specific action within a CIS Control. Version 8.1 has 153 Safeguards.

CIS's tiers for prioritizing Safeguards: IG1 is essential cyber hygiene for every organization, IG2 adds Safeguards for organizations with more complex IT, and IG3 adds Safeguards for organizations facing sophisticated attacks.

families.name: Inventory and Control of Enterprise Assets

controls.title: Enterprise asset inventory
controls.description: A detailed inventory of all enterprise assets (end-user devices, servers, network devices, IoT and cloud assets) is kept current, with owner and location.
controls.guidance: Compare the inventory with network discovery, DHCP, MDM and cloud console data, and check it is reviewed at least every six months. Implementation group: IG1 and above (essential cyber hygiene).

objectives.text: An inventory records every enterprise asset with owner, location and network address.
The inventory is reviewed and updated at least every six months.

controls.title: Unauthorized assets and discovery
controls.description: Unauthorized assets are found and removed, quarantined or added to the inventory, using active or passive discovery.
controls.guidance: Look for discovery tool output, a process for handling unknown devices, and evidence of action taken. Implementation group: IG1 and above (essential cyber hygiene).

objectives.text: Unauthorized assets are addressed at least weekly.
An active or passive discovery tool identifies assets on the network.

families.name: Inventory and Control of Software Assets

controls.title: Software inventory
controls.description: An inventory of installed software is kept, and only supported software is authorized for use.
controls.guidance: Review the software inventory or asset management tool and check for end-of-life software and exceptions. Implementation group: IG1 and above (essential cyber hygiene).

objectives.text: A software inventory records title, publisher, version and business purpose.
Unsupported software is removed or has a documented exception with mitigations.

controls.title: Unauthorized software and allowlisting
controls.description: Unauthorized software is detected and removed, and application allowlisting limits what can run.
controls.guidance: Check software inventory tooling, removal of unauthorized software and allowlisting of applications, libraries and scripts on higher-risk assets. Implementation group: IG2 and above.

objectives.text: Unauthorized software is removed or documented as an exception at least monthly.
Allowlisting controls which applications and scripts can run.

controls.title: Data management and inventory
controls.description: A data management process covers sensitivity, ownership, retention and disposal, and a data inventory identifies sensitive data.
controls.guidance: Review the data management process, data inventory, retention schedule and disposal records. Implementation group: IG1 and above (essential cyber hygiene).

objectives.text: A documented data management process covers handling, retention and disposal.
A data inventory identifies where sensitive data is held.
Data is retained and securely disposed of according to schedule.

controls.title: Access to data and encryption
controls.description: Access to data is restricted by need to know, and sensitive data is encrypted on end-user devices, removable media, in transit and at rest.
controls.guidance: Check data access control lists, full-disk encryption on laptops, and encryption in transit and at rest for sensitive data. Implementation group: IG1 and above (essential cyber hygiene).

objectives.text: Data access is configured on need to know.
End-user devices holding sensitive data use full-disk encryption.
Sensitive data is encrypted in transit and at rest.

controls.title: Data classification, segmentation and leakage prevention
controls.description: Data is classified, processing of sensitive data is segmented, and data loss prevention detects unauthorized transfers.
controls.guidance: Review the classification scheme, data flows, segmentation of systems processing sensitive data and DLP tooling. Implementation group: IG2 and above.

objectives.text: A data classification scheme is documented and applied.
Data flows of sensitive data are documented.
Data loss prevention or equivalent monitoring is in place for sensitive data.

families.name: Secure Configuration of Enterprise Assets and Software

controls.title: Secure configuration process
controls.description: Secure configuration baselines exist for enterprise assets and software, and are applied and maintained.
controls.guidance: Review documented baselines (for example derived from CIS Benchmarks) and configuration compliance scans. Implementation group: IG1 and above (essential cyber hygiene).

objectives.text: Documented secure configurations exist for each asset and software type.
Configurations are applied and checked for drift.

controls.title: Hardening essentials
controls.description: Firewalls are enabled, default accounts are managed, unnecessary services are disabled, and devices lock after inactivity.
controls.guidance: Sample assets for host firewalls, session locking, default account changes and disabled services, and check secure management protocols. Implementation group: IG1 and above (essential cyber hygiene).

objectives.text: Host-based firewalls or port filtering are enabled on servers and end-user devices.
Default accounts are disabled or have changed credentials.
Sessions lock automatically after a defined period of inactivity.

controls.title: Remote wipe and DNS
controls.description: Portable devices can be remotely wiped, and trusted DNS servers are used.
controls.guidance: Check MDM remote wipe capability and DNS configuration of enterprise assets. Implementation group: IG2 and above.

objectives.text: Lost or stolen portable devices can be remotely wiped.
Enterprise assets use trusted DNS servers.

controls.title: Account inventory and lifecycle
controls.description: An inventory of all accounts is kept, and accounts are created, reviewed and disabled through a defined process, including dormant accounts.
controls.guidance: Compare the account inventory with HR records, check dormant account handling and quarterly reviews. Implementation group: IG1 and above (essential cyber hygiene).

objectives.text: An inventory lists user, administrator and service accounts with owners.
Dormant accounts are disabled after a defined period of inactivity.
Accounts are reviewed at least quarterly.

controls.title: Passwords and administrator accounts
controls.description: Unique passwords are used for every account, and administrator activity uses dedicated accounts.
controls.guidance: Check password policy, password manager use, and separation of administrator and everyday accounts. Implementation group: IG1 and above (essential cyber hygiene).

objectives.text: Each account has a unique password meeting the documented policy.
Administrators use dedicated privileged accounts separate from their everyday accounts.

controls.title: Granting and revoking access
controls.description: Access is granted through a defined, approved process and revoked promptly on termination or role change.
controls.guidance: Sample joiners, movers and leavers for approval and timely revocation. Implementation group: IG1 and above (essential cyber hygiene).

objectives.text: Access requests are approved before access is granted.
Access is revoked promptly on termination or role change.

controls.title: Multi-factor authentication
controls.description: Multi-factor authentication is required for externally exposed applications, remote network access and administrative access.
controls.guidance: Check MFA enforcement in identity providers, VPN and administrative consoles, and any exemptions. Implementation group: IG1 and above (essential cyber hygiene).

objectives.text: MFA is enforced for externally exposed applications.
MFA is enforced for remote network access.
MFA is enforced for all administrative access.

controls.title: Centralized and role-based access
controls.description: Authentication and access control are centralized, and access is granted through defined roles reviewed periodically.
controls.guidance: Review directory or SSO integration of applications and role definitions with review evidence. Implementation group: IG2 and above.

objectives.text: Authentication is centralized through a directory or SSO service.
Access is assigned through defined roles that are reviewed periodically.

controls.title: Vulnerability management process
controls.description: A vulnerability management process defines scanning, prioritization and remediation timeframes, and operating systems and applications are patched automatically or on schedule.
controls.guidance: Review the documented process, patch management tooling and patch compliance reports. Implementation group: IG1 and above (essential cyber hygiene).

objectives.text: A documented vulnerability management process is reviewed annually.
Operating system and application patches are applied at least monthly.

controls.title: Vulnerability scanning and remediation
controls.description: Internal and external vulnerability scans run at defined intervals, and findings are remediated on a risk basis.
controls.guidance: Review scan schedules, authenticated scan coverage and remediation tracking. Implementation group: IG2 and above.

objectives.text: Authenticated internal scans run at least quarterly.
External scans of exposed assets run at least monthly.
Detected vulnerabilities are remediated within documented timeframes.

controls.title: Audit logging
controls.description: An audit log management process defines what is logged, and logging is enabled across enterprise assets with enough storage.
controls.guidance: Review the logging standard and check log configuration on a sample of assets. Implementation group: IG1 and above (essential cyber hygiene).

objectives.text: A documented process defines logging requirements.
Audit logging is enabled on enterprise assets.
Log storage is sufficient for the retention period.

controls.title: Log collection, review and retention
controls.description: Logs are collected centrally, time-synchronized, reviewed for anomalies and retained for at least 90 days.
controls.guidance: Check central log management, time synchronization, review records and retention settings. Implementation group: IG2 and above.

objectives.text: Logs are collected centrally with synchronized timestamps.
Logs are reviewed at defined intervals to detect anomalies.
Logs are retained for at least 90 days.

controls.title: Browser and email client hygiene
controls.description: Only supported browsers and email clients are allowed, and DNS filtering blocks access to known malicious domains.
controls.guidance: Check allowed browsers and email clients and DNS filtering configuration. Implementation group: IG1 and above (essential cyber hygiene).

objectives.text: Only fully supported browsers and email clients are used.
DNS filtering services block known malicious domains.

controls.title: Email security
controls.description: Email is protected with anti-spoofing (DMARC, SPF, DKIM), attachment filtering and URL filtering.
controls.guidance: Check DMARC policy, mail gateway attachment and URL filtering settings. Implementation group: IG2 and above.

objectives.text: DMARC, SPF and DKIM are implemented.
Unnecessary file types are blocked at the email gateway.
Network-based URL filtering is enforced.

controls.title: Anti-malware
controls.description: Anti-malware software is deployed, kept current automatically, and autorun of removable media is disabled.
controls.guidance: Check the anti-malware console for coverage and signature currency, and autorun settings. Implementation group: IG1 and above (essential cyber hygiene).

objectives.text: Anti-malware software is deployed on all enterprise assets.
Signatures update automatically.
Autorun and autoplay for removable media are disabled.

controls.title: Central management and behavior-based protection
controls.description: Anti-malware is centrally managed, scans removable media, and uses behavior-based detection with anti-exploitation features enabled.
controls.guidance: Review central management, removable media scanning and EDR or behavior-based features. Implementation group: IG2 and above.

objectives.text: Anti-malware is centrally managed.
Behavior-based detection and anti-exploitation features are enabled.

controls.title: Data recovery process and backups
controls.description: A data recovery process defines scope and priorities, and automated backups of in-scope assets run at least weekly.
controls.guidance: Review the data recovery process, backup schedules and success monitoring. Implementation group: IG1 and above (essential cyber hygiene).

objectives.text: A documented data recovery process defines scope, priority and backup security.
Automated backups of in-scope assets run at least weekly.

controls.title: Protected and isolated backups
controls.description: Recovery data is protected like the original data, and an isolated copy is maintained.
controls.guidance: Check backup encryption, access restrictions and an offline, immutable or otherwise isolated copy. Implementation group: IG1 and above (essential cyber hygiene).

objectives.text: Backups are protected with controls equivalent to the original data.
An isolated copy of recovery data is maintained.

controls.title: Recovery testing
controls.description: Data recovery is tested at least quarterly for a sample of in-scope assets.
controls.guidance: Review restore test records and results. Implementation group: IG2 and above.

objectives.text: Restores are tested at least quarterly and results recorded.

controls.title: Network infrastructure maintenance
controls.description: Network infrastructure is kept up to date, and network architecture is documented.
controls.guidance: Check firmware and software versions of network devices and current network diagrams. Implementation group: IG1 and above (essential cyber hygiene).

objectives.text: Network devices run supported, up-to-date software.
Network architecture and diagrams are documented and reviewed annually.

controls.title: Secure network architecture and administration
controls.description: Network architecture is segmented, network devices are managed through secure protocols and dedicated resources, and remote access requires authentication through a central service.
controls.guidance: Review segmentation, secure management protocols, centralized network AAA and VPN configuration. Implementation group: IG2 and above.

objectives.text: The network is segmented by function and trust level.
Network devices are administered over secure protocols with centralized authentication.
Remote access requires a VPN and authentication before connecting to enterprise resources.

controls.title: Network monitoring and alerting
controls.description: Security events across the network are centralized and alerted on, and intrusion detection is deployed.
controls.guidance: Review SIEM alerting, network and host intrusion detection, and alert handling. Implementation group: IG2 and above.

objectives.text: Security event alerting is centralized.
Network-based intrusion detection is deployed on key segments.
Alerts are triaged and investigated.

controls.title: Network access control and filtering
controls.description: Traffic between network segments is filtered, and access to the network is controlled at the port or application level.
controls.guidance: Check inter-segment filtering, port-level access control and remote asset security requirements. Implementation group: IG2 and above.

objectives.text: Traffic between network segments is filtered.
Access to the network is controlled at port or application level.

controls.title: Security awareness program
controls.description: A security awareness program trains the workforce at hire and at least annually on social engineering, authentication, data handling and incident reporting.
controls.guidance: Review training content, completion tracking and phishing simulations. Implementation group: IG1 and above (essential cyber hygiene).

objectives.text: Workforce members complete awareness training at hire and at least annually.
Training covers social engineering, authentication, data handling and how to report incidents.

controls.title: Role-specific training
controls.description: People in security-relevant roles receive role-specific security training.
controls.guidance: Check training records for administrators, developers and other specialist roles. Implementation group: IG2 and above.

objectives.text: Role-specific security training is delivered to people in security-relevant roles.

controls.title: Service provider inventory and policy
controls.description: An inventory of service providers is kept, with a classification and a policy for managing them.
controls.guidance: Review the service provider inventory, classification by data sensitivity and criticality, and the management policy. Implementation group: IG1 and above (essential cyber hygiene).

objectives.text: An inventory of service providers records their classification and contact.
A service provider management policy is documented.

controls.title: Contracts, assessment and decommissioning
controls.description: Contracts include security requirements, providers are assessed and monitored, and decommissioning includes data return or disposal.
controls.guidance: Sample contracts for security clauses, assessment records and decommissioning evidence. Implementation group: IG2 and above.

objectives.text: Contracts include security requirements, including breach notification.
Service providers are assessed and monitored according to their classification.
Decommissioning ensures account deactivation and data disposal.

controls.title: Secure development process
controls.description: A secure application development process covers design, secure coding, third-party components and vulnerability handling.
controls.guidance: Review the secure development process, inventory of third-party components, and the process for receiving and fixing software vulnerabilities. Implementation group: IG2 and above.

objectives.text: A documented secure development process is followed.
Third-party software components are inventoried and kept up to date.
A process exists to accept and address reports of software vulnerabilities.

controls.title: Application security testing
controls.description: Applications are tested with static and dynamic analysis, and development and production environments are separated.
controls.guidance: Check SAST and DAST use, code review and environment separation. Implementation group: IG2 and above.

objectives.text: Static and dynamic application security testing is performed.
Production and non-production environments are separated.

controls.title: Incident response process
controls.description: Incident response roles are designated, contact information is maintained, and a process exists for the workforce to report incidents.
controls.guidance: Review the named incident handler and deputies, contact lists and the reporting process. Implementation group: IG1 and above (essential cyber hygiene).

objectives.text: A person and a backup are designated to manage incident handling.
Contact information for incident reporting and external parties is maintained.
A process for reporting incidents is documented and communicated.

controls.title: Incident response plan and exercises
controls.description: An incident response plan defines roles, communication and recovery, and is exercised at least annually with post-incident reviews.
controls.guidance: Review the plan, exercise records and post-incident reviews. Implementation group: IG2 and above.

objectives.text: A documented incident response plan defines roles, communication and recovery steps.
Incident response exercises are conducted at least annually.
Post-incident reviews are conducted and lessons applied.

controls.title: Penetration testing program
controls.description: A penetration testing program defines scope, frequency and handling of findings, and external penetration tests are performed at least annually.
controls.guidance: Review the program, recent test reports and remediation tracking. Implementation group: IG2 and above.

objectives.text: A penetration testing program is documented.
External penetration tests are performed at least annually.
Findings are remediated according to the organization's remediation policy.

controls.title: Internal penetration testing
controls.description: Internal penetration tests are performed at least annually, and security measures are validated after testing.
controls.guidance: Review internal test reports and changes to security measures that resulted. Implementation group: IG3 only.

objectives.text: Internal penetration tests are performed at least annually.
Security measures are validated or modified based on test results.
